data.title: 伽玛 · 度假酒店露台视察
data.description: 四越商会新建的度假酒店露台上，伽玛扶着栏杆俯瞰海湾。她在心里计算着开业首季的客流，晚礼服的裙摆被海风轻轻吹起。
data.location: terrace of a luxury seaside resort hotel overlooking a bay at sunset
data.action: standing at the terrace railing overlooking the bay, hand on rail, evening gown hem fluttering in sea breeze
data.lighting: 海湾黄昏的落日熔金与露台灯串
data.mood: expansive merchant vision, sea breeze elegance
data.promptProse: On the new resort's terrace, Gamma gazes over the bay, already counting the first season's guests.
data.animaCaption: The bay, the hotel, the numbers — all of it is Mitsugoshi's future, and Gamma sees it clearly.
